alignment.note: The Vulgate entirely omits this verse (Mark 9:32), which in Greek and Peshitta describes the disciples' failure to understand Jesus' passion prediction and their fear of questioning him. The Vulgate text instead continues with verse 33 (arrival at Capernaum and Jesus' question about their discussion on the road), creating a textual discontinuity with the Greek and Syriac witnesses.

The Vulgate inserts the entirety of Mark 9:33 ('Et venerunt Capharnaum. Qui cum domi essent, interrogabat eos: Quid in via tractabatis?'), which belongs to the subsequent pericope in Greek and Peshitta manuscript traditions. This represents either a versification error in the Clementine edition or a scribal conflation of two distinct narrative units.
